tuv.seg: Operators shall only move live fishing bait that are aquatic animals of listed species relevant for category D diseases, other than those listed in column 4 of the table in the Annex to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/1882 and which are not regarded as vectors, into a Member State, zone or a compartment which has disease-free status, or which is subject to an eradication programme to obtain disease-free status for one or more of those relevant category D diseases, if such live fishing baits originate from a disease-free Member State, zone or compartment.
